title: Tool dispatch calibration & contract-validation pipeline for function-calling regressions
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Background: We have recurring regressions when models or runtime config changes subtly alter the tool-selection distribution and argument formats. These regressions manifest as wrong tool choices, malformed arguments, or silent failures downstream in function execution. Current evals catch some regressions intermittently but lack a continuous, schema-aware pipeline that ties selection accuracy and argument contract validity to config/model rollouts.

Goal: Build a production-ready pipeline that (1) calibrates the tool-dispatch classifier when models/configs change, (2) validates tool argument contracts against a schema-driven checker, and (3) surfaces actionable alerts and diffs tied to PRs and rollout events. This ticket scopes the core harness and the monitoring alerts for the first rollout (hosted API + Dedicated).

Scope and non-scope: In-scope: offline evaluation harness, streaming shadow-run integration, schema-based arg validator, selection confusion matrices, alert thresholds, dashboard panels. Out-of-scope: automated auto-rollbacks, full A/B user-facing experiments (will be follow-up).
acceptance_criteria: A reproducible offline evaluation job that runs new model/config candidate against a baseline on a holdout tool-calling dataset and emits per-tool selection precision/recall/confusion matrix
A schema-driven argument validator that verifies types, required fields, enums, and cross-field invariants and reports per-call pass/fail with examples
A continuous shadow pipeline that can run 1% of live traffic through the candidate model/config and compare tool-selection and arg-validation rates without impacting production responses
Alerting rules defined: selection accuracy drop >5% for any high-frequency tool OR arg-validation pass rate <98% triggers an incident channel with links to top failing examples
Dashboard panels in Console showing time-series for selection accuracy, arg-validation pass rate, per-tool confusion matrix heatmap, and recent failing examples with linked PR/rollout metadata
Integration tests and a demo PR that shows the pipeline catching a synthetic regression (included as test harness)
tasks: Design evaluation dataset: consolidate curated tool-calling examples (customer-like + edge cases) and define training/baseline split
Implement schema-driven validator library (Type + coercion rules + invariant checks + actionable error messages)
Offline evaluation job: runner that loads baseline and candidate model/config and emits metrics and examples
Shadowing integration: implement 1% non-blocking proxy path to fork requests to candidate and record outcomes
Alerting and thresholds: create PagerDuty + Slack hooks and define threshold rules in alerts playbook
Console dashboard: build panels and example list view for quick triage
Write integration tests and a synthetic regression PR demonstrating end-to-end detection
Documentation: runbook, how to interpret confusion matrices, remediation playbook
metrics: overall_tool_selection_accuracy: percent of requests where selected tool matches ground truth
per_tool_precision_recall: precision and recall per tool id
arg_validation_pass_rate: percent of tool calls passing schema validation
shadow_agreement_rate: percent of shadowed requests where candidate agrees with baseline on tool selection
time_to_detection: median time from rollout to alert when a synthetic regression is introduced

risks: False positives from schema strictness leading to noisy alerts — mitigated by staged thresholds and manual review flow
Performance impact if shadowing path is misconfigured (ensure 1% non-blocking asynchronous fork)
Schema drift as tools evolve — require versioned schemas and automated contract validation in CI
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (offline): weekly batch job comparing candidate to baseline and publish report to Console
Phase 2 (shadow): enable 1% shadowing for a single internal org and monitor for 72 hours
Phase 3 (canary): enable 10% traffic with automatic rollback guardrails if alerts fire
Phase 4 (full): promote to critical rollout monitoring for all model/config changes
how_to_triage: Review top failing examples in Console -> Evals -> Tool Dispatch
Check confusion matrix to identify if errors are concentrated (single tool misclassification) or scattered
If arg-validation failures: inspect schema version and failing fields; check whether errors are coercion vs missing required field
If spike in selection errors following model upgrade: correlate with PR that changed tokenization/config or model family
Escalate to Model Onboarding or Runtime team depending on root cause
